title: Yellowed Crisp Portuguese Pork Back Ribs Kebabs
description: A salty and crisp Portuguese dish featuring pork back ribs cooked to perfection in a tandoor, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the pork back ribs to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated pork ribs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Place the skewers in the tandoor and cook for 20 minutes, or until the ribs are crispy and golden brown
Brush the ribs with lemon juice during the last 5 minutes of cooking
Remove the skewers from the tandoor and garnish with bay leaves
Serve the Yellowed Crisp Portuguese Pork Back Ribs Kebabs hot and enjoy
